commands.name: computer_info
commands.command: Get-ComputerInfo | Select-Object CsName, WindowsProductName, WindowsVersion, OsArchitecture
commands.output:
CsName           WindowsProductName              WindowsVersion OsArchitecture
EXAMPLE-WIN-HOST Windows Server 2022 Datacenter 2009           64-bit

commands.name: drives
commands.command: Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Select-Object Name, Used, Free

commands.name: listening_tcp_ports
commands.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess

commands.name: services_not_running
commands.command: Get-Service | Where-Object Status -ne "Running" | Select-Object -First 20 Name, Status, StartType
commands.output:
Name     Status StartType
Spooler Stopped    Manual

commands.name: top_cpu_processes
commands.command: Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name, Id, CPU, WorkingSet

commands.name: powershell_repositories
commands.output:
Name      InstallationPolicy SourceLocation
PSGallery Trusted            https://www.powershellgallery.com/api/v2

commands.name: firewall_profiles
commands.output:
Name    Enabled DefaultInboundAction DefaultOutboundAction
Domain     True                Block                Allow
Private    True                Block                Allow
Public     True                Block                Allow
